quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: Solidigm to Discontinue Review of Potential IPO, (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SK hynix (release on its U.S. NAND / SSD subsidiary Solidigm): growing AI-era memory demand presents growth opportunities for Solidigm, but its existing production facilities have limited capacity to meet rising demand, so Solidigm needs to secure additional production facilities in the U.S.; SK hynix will continue to assess the investment timing and scale.
